pokedexEntries.sw: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

pokedexEntries.sc: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.

pokedexEntries.vi: When some Lechonk come along to lick the sweet nectar on Appletun's back, Appletun will spew sticky nectar at them to drive them away.
